output.reply:
Hi Bilal, sorry to hear Slotwise isn't working for you. To help us pinpoint the problem, could you tell us a bit more?

- What exactly isn't working (for example the booking page, Google Calendar sync, or the dashboard)?
- Any error message you see, ideally with a screenshot
- When it started, and whether it affects everyone or only some staff or services

In the meantime, you can check live status at status.slotwise.test. You can also try a different browser or a private window and clear the cache. If clients can't book, please include your booking page link so our team can look into it right away.

Slotwise Support
